## Summary of Work So Far

### What Has Been Done:
1. Read the entire `parse.py` file (1318 lines) - understood the complete library structure
2. Read the entire `test_parse.py` file (973 lines) - understood existing test coverage

### What Is Pending:
I need to implement 10 requirements (R1-R10):

- **[R1]** Add 'letters' format specifier matching alphabetic characters only (distinct from 'w')
- **[R2]** Add `__contains__` method to Result class
- **[R3]** Raise error when braces are not fully enclosed in matching braces  
- **[R4]** Fix FixedTzOffset timezone offset parsing (Bug 92)
- **[R5]** Support Fortran-formatted floating-point numbers
- **[R6]** Correctly identify/convert hex, binary, octal integers with base arguments and auto-detection
- **[R7]** Replace lambdas with picklable functors in conversion functions
- **[R8]** Make findall respect case_sensitive parameter
- **[R9]** Left/center-aligned search must consume input up to next space
- **[R10]** Add slice access support to Result instances

### Current State:
No changes have been made yet. I need to first run the existing tests to establish a passing baseline, then implement each requirement while ensuring all existing tests continue to pass.

### Rules/Announcements:
- Cannot modify test files or packaging/test configuration
- Cannot add test plumbing (conftest.py, sitecustomize.py, etc.)
- Cannot download anything from network
- Cannot read version-control history beyond current commit
- Must write STATUS.json at completion mapping each requirement ID to probability (0-1)
- Can end with GIVE_UP if unable to finish
